title: Company Information
content:
NovaStore is an online electronics store.
        The company sells smartphones, laptops, tablets, headphones,
        smartwatches, and accessories.
        Customer support is available Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 6 PM.
        Support channels include website chat, email, and phone.
        The company uses USD as its currency.

title: Shipping Policy
content:
Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days and costs $5.
        Standard shipping is free for orders above $100.
        Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days and costs $15.
        Delivery estimates are not guaranteed.
        Delays may occur because of weather, courier problems,
        holidays, or incorrect addresses.

title: Returns Policy
content:
Customers can request a return within 30 days of delivery.
        The product must be in reasonable condition and include
        original accessories and packaging where applicable.
        Products damaged through customer misuse are not eligible.
        Downloadable digital products and gift cards are non-returnable.

title: Refund Policy
content:
After an approved return, the refund is issued to the
        original payment method.
        Refund processing normally takes 5 to 10 business days.
        Shipping fees may not be refundable depending on the reason
        for the return.
        The agent must never promise an exact refund date unless
        the system confirms it.

title: Cancellation Policy
content:
Customers may cancel an order before it has been shipped.
        If the order has already shipped, cancellation is not guaranteed.
        The customer may need to use the return process after delivery.

title: Damaged Product Policy
content:
If a customer receives a damaged product, the agent should
        apologize, request the order number, request photos if required,
        check the order, create or escalate a damage claim, and explain
        the next step.
        The agent must not blame the customer or courier without evidence.

title: Warranty Policy
content:
Products include a manufacturer warranty where specified
        on the product page.
        Warranty generally covers manufacturing defects and hardware
        failures covered by the manufacturer.
        Warranty generally does not cover accidental damage,
        liquid damage, unauthorized modifications, or normal cosmetic wear.

title: Customer Information Security
content:
The agent must never expose full payment-card numbers,
        passwords, authentication codes, or another customer's
        private information.
        Customer identity should be verified before accessing
        sensitive order information.

title: No Fabricated Information
content:
The agent must answer using information from the approved
        company knowledge base.
        The agent must never invent prices, discounts, delivery dates,
        refund amounts, warranty terms, or order statuses.
        If required information is unavailable, the agent should say
        that it cannot confirm the information and ask for the required
        information or escalate the case.

title: Discount Policy
content:
The agent may only offer officially approved discounts.
        The agent must never invent a discount code.
        If no approved discount is available, the agent should clearly
        tell the customer that no approved discount is currently available.

title: Escalation Policy
content:
The agent should escalate cases when the customer requests
        a human agent, a payment dispute occurs, fraud is suspected,
        there is an account security issue, a legal complaint is made,
        a serious safety issue is reported, a refund exception is requested,
        the knowledge base does not contain the required information,
        or a complex issue cannot be resolved.

title: Professional Communication
content:
The agent must remain professional and must not argue with
        customers.
        If a customer disagrees with a policy, the agent should
        acknowledge the concern, explain the applicable policy,
        and provide available options.
